extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners in multimodal machine learning, computer vision, and visual storytelling
extracted.subtask_description: Developing, fine-tuning, and evaluating models that generate narratives grounded in images (visual storytelling) using large language and vision-language models, new datasets, and both automated and human evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Higher scores in narrative coherence are a target outcome for the proposed approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an evaluation dimension; the paper reports quantitative evaluations (with GPT-4) and qualitative human assessments showing improved narrative coherence. Coherence is tied to properly aligning visual and textual information across a story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Generated narratives should be relevant to the input visual content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as an evaluation metric (automated via GPT-4 and via human judgments). Relevance here emphasizes that textual content must meaningfully reflect the visual elements and context provided by images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional depth
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories should exhibit emotional resonance and depth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as an evaluation dimension where the proposed method achieves higher scores; assessed both by GPT-4 scoring and human qualitative assessment. Emotional depth is a desirable quality for engaging visual stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall quality
rubrics_metrics.description: A holistic assessment of the generated visual stories' quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treated as an aggregate evaluation outcome combining factors like coherence, relevance, emotional depth, and fluency; measured via GPT-4 and human evaluations to compare models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment of visual and textual information
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective alignment between images and generated text is necessary to produce coherent, contextually appropriate stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identified as a core challenge in visual storytelling; the paper's approach (combining LLMs and LVLMs with instruction tuning) is explicitly intended to address this alignment problem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset diversity and annotation quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of a new dataset comprising diverse visual stories annotated with detailed captions and multimodal elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dataset design should include diversity of stories and fine-grained annotations (detailed captions, multimodal elements) to support training and evaluation of storytelling models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction tuning effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Leveraging instruction tuning on LLMs/LVLMs to improve narrative generation capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction tuning is presented as a key methodological ingredient; effectiveness is judged by downstream improvements in evaluation metrics (coherence, relevance, emotional depth, overall quality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fine-tuning with supervised and reinforcement learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Combining supervised learning and reinforcement learning for model fine-tuning to enhance narrative generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The method employs both supervised and reinforcement learning; success is assessed by improved performance on the quantitative and qualitative evaluation measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated evaluation using GPT-4
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantitative evaluations employ GPT-4 to score generated stories along target dimensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GPT-4 is used as an automated scorer for dimensions such as coherence, relevance, and emotional depth; reported improvements are based in part on these automated evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative human assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Human judgments are used to qualitatively assess narrative quality and corroborate automated metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human evaluators provide qualitative assessments of stories (e.g., emotional resonance, naturalness), serving as an important complement to automated GPT-4 scoring for validating model performance.
